method.before: Base division/coercion, high-scale fallback, selective exact-scale normalization, filter/projection fix; original DataFusion ROUND.
method.after: Same candidate plus the existing Decimal256 constant preparation and quotient-reuse patches, unchanged.
method.dependency_overrides: Both variants use identical local functions and physical-plan paths and one candidate lockfile. Only src/math/round.rs changes between their builds.
method.scope: Execution-only, preloaded Arrow arrays, release, CPU 2, one partition, 1048576 rows, batch size 8192. All builds and correctness checks finish before timing.
method.counter_scope: Fresh selected-case processes, separate from the full-suite samples. perf stat starts disabled; FIFO acknowledgements enable after two warmups and disable after nine executions. Counts include handshake/loop bookkeeping, exclude setup/planning/warmups/formatting/cleanup.
method.counter_interpretation: CPU per execution is task-clock:u / 9. Instructions/cycles count user-mode work. Software diagnostics retain their qualifiers and do not establish absence of scheduler activity. No frequency inference.
method.retention: All raw samples and slow processes retained. Median uses all 36 full-suite samples per case/variant; mean uses the same samples. Profiled samples remain separate.
method.limits: One machine, unfixed CPU frequency and possible SMT interference. Same plans and instructions do not prove equal performance. This tests the integration, not complete Spark compatibility or end-to-end Delta latency.
